claims.quote: Pathogenic variants in GRIN2B are predominantly associated with neurodevelopmental disorders (NDDs).
Variants located in the transmembrane domain predominantly resulted in a GOF effect.
GOF variants were more likely to cause epilepsy and microcephaly than LOF variants.

Two of these individuals (carrying the p.Ile641Thr and p.Met818Leu variants, respectively) achieved seizure control after receiving memantine.
memantine has been shown to be effective in controlling seizures and improving cognition.
Moreover, in comparison to LOF truncated variants, missense variants were associated with more severe clinical phenotypes, including severe DD/ID, language delay, and movement disorders.
The clinical manifestations included severe developmental delay /intellectual disability (DD/ID) and hypotonia in 100% of cases, as well as microcephaly in 28.57% of cases.
